title: The Illusion of Clinical Reasoning: A Benchmark Reveals the Pervasive Gap in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Competency

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) using an adversarial task (Task VIII) that presents deliberately mismatched clinical text and medical images to test if models over-rely on text prompts (text-driven hallucinations) and ignore contradictory visual evidence.
